def myRev : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => myRev xs ++ [x]

theorem myRev_append_single (xs : List α) (x : α) : myRev (xs ++ [x]) = x :: myRev xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [myRev]
  | cons y ys ih =>
      simp [myRev, ih, List.append_assoc]

theorem myRev_myRev (xs : List α) : myRev (myRev xs) = xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rw [myRev, myRev_append_single, ih]
